text: Deadlines are a part of professional life, and handling them well is a valuable skill. The key is effective time management. Instead of feeling overwhelmed by a large project, break it down into smaller, manageable tasks with their own mini-deadlines. Prioritization is also crucial; focus on the most important or urgent tasks first, and don't be afraid to delegate when possible. Sometimes, you may realize that the original scope of the project is unrealistic within the given time frame. In such cases, it's better to communicate this early with your manager or client rather than waiting until the last minute. A clear conversation about what can be achieved can lead to adjusting the deadline or the project's requirements, ensuring a successful outcome for everyone.
